issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Meal is inconsistent: the problem statement UML and examples specify a constructor Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), and the solution implementation defines public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), but the template implementation defines public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name). This mismatch will cause compilation errors for students who follow the examples in the problem statement or use the provided Main (which constructs Meal with (String, String[])).
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template constructor signature to public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) so it matches the UML in the problem statement, the examples in Main, and the solution. Alternatively, if the reversed parameter order is intentional, update the problem statement examples and UML to use Meal(String[] ingredients, String name), but changing the template to (String name, String[] ingredients) is recommended to avoid compilation failures for students.

issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Meal is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement UML declares the constructor as Meal(String, String[]) (i.e., Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)). The template implementation declares the constructor as public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name) (parameters reversed). The template Main usage constructs Meal objects with new Meal("cowBoyStew", new String[]{...}) (matching the UML and solution). The solution implementation declares public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients). This mismatch will cause compilation errors for students using the provided Main examples and makes it unclear which parameter is the meal name versus the ingredients array.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Meal constructor signature to match the problem statement and the solution: public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients). Update the parameter assignment in the constructor body accordingly so name is assigned to the name field and ingredients to the ingredients field. Ensure example calls (Main) and any documentation remain consistent with this parameter order.
